docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The Bhāvārthadīpikā of Jñāneśvar (Dnyaneshwar), composed at Nevāse in 1290 according to its closing verses: nearly nine thousand ovī verses that expound the Gītā chapter by chapter in Old Marathi, with images from village life, and one of the founding works of Marathi literature and of the Vārkarī tradition of Paṇḍharpūr. The text as transcribed on Marathi Wikisource.

From Wikisource · Public domain

Jñāneśvar, Jñāneśvarī (1290): the Marathi text as transcribed on Marathi Wikisource by its contributors. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from Wikisource when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Licence: Public domain.
